The '''1956–57 [[La Liga]]''' was the 26th season since its establishment. The season began on 9 September 1956, and concluded on 21 April 1957. [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] won their fifth title.

==Format changes==
For this season, the relegation playoffs was eliminated and the two last qualified teams were directly relegated to Segunda División.
